storage for the six large Algarve reservoirs (Arade, Funcho, Bravura, Odelouca, Odeleite, Beliche) as a chart

why.quote: Armazenamento de Água Superficial (albufeiras) APA Semanal
why.basis: report text stating APA monitors surface storage weekly; the report states no reuse licence, and the APA site footer reads 'APA © 2021 - Consulte aqui a Política de privacidade da APA.' (https://apambiente.pt/, read 2026-11-18). robots.txt (https://apambiente.pt/robots.txt, 200): 'User-agent: * / Allow: / / Disallow: /adm/ / Disallow: /user/'. Not a reuse licence.

interface: Index page https://apambiente.pt/agua/ano-hidrologico-20252026 (HTML) links one PDF per month, numbered: 119_Relatorio_Monitorizacao_30Set2026.pdf is the newest (about 5.8 MB, ~60 pages, text layer readable with pdftotext). URL pattern /sites/default/files/_SNIAMB_Agua/DRH/OrgaosConsultivos/ComissaoPermanenteSeca/Relatorios/<n>_Relatorio_Monitorizacao_<DDMonYYYY>.pdf. No key. No JSON or CSV.
notes: Read 18 Nov 2026: the index page and the 30 Sep 2026 report (one download, 5.8 MB). Monthly, published after month end, so the November picture is about 4 to 6 weeks old; as of 18 Nov the 31 Oct report was not yet listed. The report's own Tabela 1 says APA monitors surface storage weekly but only the monthly PDF is public here; the weekly series lives on SNIRH (403, see gap). Tabela (30 Set 2026, AdA group): Beliche 31.17 hm3, 64.93%; Bravura 26.97 hm3, 77.44%; Odeleite 94.80 hm3, 72.93%; Odelouca 115.11 hm3, 73.32% (the table has four date columns; I took the last as 30 Sep, not checked against the column header). Arade and Funcho appear only in a chart image (Figura 21), so would need image reading or SNIRH. Figures need cross-checking against the page layout before any build. Same reports are mirrored by GPP (https://www.gpp.pt/images/Estatisticas_e_analises/Analises/MonitorizaSeca/Relatorio_Monitorizacao_<mes>_<ano>.pdf; gpp.pt robots: User-agent * disallows only Joomla system paths); not read beyond robots. Best official keyless source for all Portugal, but a PDF with free-text and tables, so extraction is brittle; no licence, so reuse of figures with attribution should be confirmed with APA.
